frames.base: floor level at the centre of the wheels; x forward, y left, z up (m); angles CCW from x
frames.world: the estimator's frame: the base pose at its last reset; drifts slowly (odometry + IMU heading)
frames.image: colour pixels (u right, v down), 640x480, origin top left
frames.color_optical: x right, y down, z forward (m), at the camera
frames.snapshot:<id>: the base frame at that snapshot's capture time

body.shape: square, centred on the base origin
body.drive: swerve (holonomic): it can translate in any direction while turning, and turn in place
body.height_note: low base (~0.17 m) with a camera mast; the mast is the tallest part

camera.top_of_image: above the horizon (sees walls and tall objects)
camera.blind_zone: the floor within ~0.74 m of the base centre (~0.53 m beyond the front edge) is never visible, nor anything beside or behind the robot

sensing_notes: only the forward camera: nothing beside or behind the robot is seen; turn to look
depth is weak on glass, mirrors, black / shiny surfaces and thin legs or cables
the stop reflex sees only what the camera sees, beyond the blind zone
